releases.title: LEVEL:3 Supreme Power of the Golden Spell

images.alt: LEVEL:3 Supreme Power of the Golden Spell
Zeno and the Most Powerful Mamodo

items.text: All 102 cards of LEVEL:3 Supreme Power of the Golden Spell are now available, with the two series-3 starter decks "Zatch Bell and His Friends" and "Zeno and the Most Powerful Mamodo"
Season 3 cards are available: LIMITED EDITION I, Spell Book File Vol. 2, Special Box, Spell Book Expansion Sheet LEVEL:1 / LEVEL:2 (Ex cards) and Promo cards, 95 cards in all
Match seasons: choose Season 1 / 2 / 3 when creating a room and both Spell Books are checked against it; the Rules page "Seasons" section lists each season's card numbers and products
Tables: 5 fixed tables let you play other players without sharing a room code, with a rematch option after the game
Tournament rules: the first player's Start Phase page turns on turn 1 give no MP; only one copy of each PR card number is allowed
Result panel: at the end of a game it shows the result, the reason, the number of turns and pages left; rematch an NPC or play again in Free Investigation
Last-page warning: when your Spell Book is on its last page you are warned that ending the turn loses the game, and the Pass button says so
Disabled buttons explain why (only during a battle, only on your action, not enough MP and so on); actions you cannot take now are shown with the reason
Estimated total Power for spells: the card view lists the MAMODO and spell Power, and choosing a user shows "Total · Cost"
"Processing…" appears right after you act, so actions are not sent twice
Spotlight on the card behind an effect, Power and Cost breakdowns, and markers for STAY effects that cannot be used
The deck builder's card pool uses an icon filter bar for type, MAMODO, product and season
Return to a game in progress from the home page; click the title to go home
Two Season 2 reference decks: Reference Deck - Zeno & Baltro S2 and Reference Deck - Brago S2
Chinese card texts were re-translated directly from the Japanese effect texts
After a coin flip, the flipper and then the opponent decide in turn whether to use effects that change the result
Power and Cost are shown as badges on the card, the card number moved to the lower right; "MAMODO-effect attack / defense" is the term used everywhere
Decks are labeled "Usable from Season N"
First-time visitors no longer see the release notes pop up
Ending the turn on the last page now loses immediately without first logging a page turn and MP +2; the page count no longer goes past 32; the reason names the loser
Several LEVEL:1 / 2 cards were fixed to follow the Japanese text and FAQ (M-001 / M-010 / M-017 work in any battle where you attack or defend, M-005, M-031, what cannot be protected, and more)
Targets and coin flips of attack and defense effects are decided at declaration; "X's spell" is judged by MAMODO name; S-057 only changes damage that has no chosen target
STAY effects stop working while they "cannot be used"; whether a card can be played and MAMODO-effect attack / defense limits are checked by the game, and the buttons are disabled
The NPC re-declares its attack correctly after an interrupt; a new room starts with an empty log; the hint next to the turn dial no longer pushes the buttons
Turn dial: the action bar shows the turn player and the acting player on a dial; after one pass it tilts 45° to warn that one more pass ends the turn
Pass and Accept buttons now explain what they do (take no more actions this turn / take no action on opponent's turn / use no BATTLE effect; or take a No-BATTLE action instead of accepting)
Power showdown: both mamodo and their spells face off in the center, with a clear "Attack succeeds" or "Defense holds"
Damage and protection effects: energy flies to the damaged Spell Book or mamodo, a protecting mamodo steps in front to take it, and discarded cards fly to the Discard Pile
Browse your Spell Book on the board with the arrow buttons; in the Start Phase, browse to the page you want and the matching flip button appears
Choose which mamodo uses a spell and which mamodo a partner attaches to, right on the board
When choosing a card, the Spell Book or Discard Pile opens automatically and says what to choose
View the cards stacked under a stacked mamodo
Sound effects in games
The home page shows how many people are playing
Maintenance notices appear at the top of the screen before maintenance
Deck builder: cards show Intermediate / Superior and the card number, with a details view; the mamodo filter has "None" to find command spells
The site is now Gash Card Battle Online, with a new title and icon
Chinese terms unified; local test mode is now called "Free Investigation"
Mamodo keep their positions on the board; when the left one leaves, the others no longer shift left
Deck builder: remove a card with the Remove button, so double-clicking no longer deletes by accident
Phone layout adjustments for the action log and Spell Book grid

Viewing a Spell Book: M-011, E-016 and E-017 can be used even if the opponent's book has no target; you see the whole book, and the opponent acts only after you finish viewing. M-018 and E-014 now show you the opponent's open pages first
Choosing effects in any order: E-021 lets you use one or both effects in the order you choose
Borrowed partner effects: an effect borrowed with E-010 stays usable after that partner leaves play
Usable without a target: P-003, P-004 and P-006 can be used any time; they just have no effect if their target isn't there
Not usable without a target: S-043 and S-048 can't be used (and cost no MP) when there is no mamodo to choose; S-043's split places the two mamodo one at a time
Timing: P-001 can only be used on your own turn; M-012 can't reflip while restricted by E-024 / E-025
Command spells: S-026 and other command spells let you choose which mamodo uses them, and the log shows them as spells
A mamodo stacked onto an injured one stays injured
Non-BATTLE spells with the same name on different pages can each be used once
Card images load faster
